messages:
ash: Heads up — onboarding mixtral-7b-v2 converted from HF. After yesterday's kernel-selection tweak (prefer small-head tiled matmul), p99 jumped ~18% on our nightly perf-run.

maggie: hmm. any clear diff in profile? batch sizes?

ash: baseline (old kernel): p99=84ms, throughput=620 tok/s. new: p99=99ms, throughput=580 tok/s. CPU spin increased on worker 2.

kevin: do you have the pprof flame? can you paste the top stacks?

ash: here are the top lines from the perf dump (stripped):

```
56.2%  runtime_bin  runtime_bin  [.] tiled_matmul_small_heads
18.4%  runtime_bin  runtime_bin  [.] kv_cache_lookup
7.1%   runtime_bin  runtime_bin  [.] attention_kernel_rope_scaled
4.0%   libc.so.6    libc.so.6    [.] memcpy
```

anita: tiled_matmul_small_heads is the new kernel we prefer for <headsize 64. Mixtral converted weights show head_size=48 in HF config?

ash: HF config had "n_heads": 80 and "d_head": 48 so head_dim=48, ok qualifies. But tiled kernel seems to thrash L2 for some shapes.

maggie: could be batching heuristic: continuous batching decided to favor larger minibatches, exposing an L2 conflict in tiled kernel. Any logs from batcher?

ash: paste from batcher trace:

```
[batcher] batch_sizes: 1,1,2,4,8,8,16,8,4,2
[batcher] chosen_kernel: tiled_matmul_small_heads (policy=heuristic:head_dim<64)
[batcher] kv_cache_hits: 0.72
[batcher] kv_evictions: 1 every ~120s
```

kevin: kv_evictions might explain increased kv_cache_lookup time — eviction/restore causing memcpy churn. Are we evicting whole layers or slices?

ash: eviction is by least-recently-used on cache entries: we evict per sequence when mem pressure arrives. For this model, keys are denser because of more heads * smaller head_dim. The cache slice size ended up being awkward for our slab allocator.

anita: two angles to try: 1) force a fallback kernel (dense_matmul) for this model; 2) tune batcher heuristic to prefer smaller batch width when head_dim<64 and seq_len>512.

maggie: can we reproduce locally with the sample prompt set? I can run the bench with --profile and HW perf counters.

ash: repro command I used:

```
./bench --model mixtral-7b-v2 --seq 1024 --batcher-mode=continuous --profile=perf --kernel-policy=auto
```

kevin: also try: --kernel-policy=fallback:dense_matmul and --kv-eviction-threshold=0.9

maggie: running now, will post results in ~15m.

[10m later]

maggie: quick results:
- auto kernel: p99=100ms (matches)
- force dense_matmul: p99=86ms (back to baseline)
- with dense_matmul + kv-eviction-threshold=0.95: p99=82ms, throughput +6%

anita: that strongly suggests kernel-memory interaction + eviction churn. We should teach the kernel selector to consider "effective_slab_util" or expected cache slice size when picking tiled_matmul_small_heads.

ash: Agreed. Also noticed safetensors metadata missing "head_dim" in some converted checkpoints which made us infer from weights -> led to mistakes for some older conversions. For this model conversion script we added a fallback calculation but maybe it's approximate.

kevin: Action items:
- (ash) add quick guard: if kv_eviction_rate > 0.2 and seq_len>512 and head_dim<64 -> prefer dense_matmul fallback.
- (anita) update kernel selector to include a heuristic: slab_util_estimate = (n_heads * d_head * seq_len) % slab_size check. Expose as a metric.
- (maggie) add a small repro to onboarding CI that runs one perf-profile and checks p99 within 10% of reference.
- (kevin) audit conversion script for missing safetensors metadata fields (head_dim, rotary_scale) and warn loudly.

ash: I'll open PR for the guard. quick note: during PR testing, use --kernel-policy=auto to ensure our selector toggles. Also add a debug line that prints selected_kernel_reason so we can triage in the future.

maggie: FYI output that helped: "selected_kernel= tiled_matmul_small_heads (reason=head_dim<64 AND policy=head_pref)". We'll make reason richer.

sre-bot: deploy job #rwd-5523 started for runtime-canary with selector patch.

anita: let's also consider a microbenchmark to measure L2 miss rate of tiled_matmul for head_dim in {32,48,64} across seq lens. Could help pick thresholds.

ash: good call. I'll add a microbench job to perf infra.

kevin: logged followup issues: rwd/infra#2044 (kernel selector slab heuristic), rwd/convert#119 (safetensors metadata warnings), rwd/ci#876 (onboarding perf gate).

maggie: confirmed repro artifact uploaded to perf bucket: s3://rwd-perf/artifacts/mixtral-onboard/2501112223.tar.gz

ash: thanks all. I'll ship the quick guard PR and link here.

[end]
